ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.title: Cleric
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.d:
A strange blue humanoid in a golden helmet smiles widely.
"[jitter]Hello friend![/jitter] I am [blue]Cleric[/blue]! Want to try my services?"
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.o: Lose [red]{PurifyCost}[/red] [gold]Gold[/gold]. Remove a card from your [gold]deck[/gold].
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.pages.HEAL.desc: A warm golden light surrounds you and fades.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.pages.PURIFY.de: Cold blue flame surrounds you and fades.
ALL_MATTERS_EVENT_CLERIC.pages.LEAVE.des: You decide not to trust this [blue]"Cleric"[/blue].
